author: QFrog
body:
Whenever I go on the forums I always see many threads about someone uploading some new video, then they do this for the next video and the next video and the next video. I am suggesting that we make a rule where users should only post there videos in one central hub and just reply to the post when there is a new video.

Basically this could cut down on a lot of forum clutter from videos.
